data.long_meaning: In Christian tradition, the name Gates symbolizes entryways to spiritual growth and the gatekeepers of wisdom and knowledge. Biblically, it references the gates of Jerusalem and the Gates of Heaven. The name Gates carries the meaning “Entrance, threshold” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gates usually hope their child will grow to embody entrance, threshold and live with faith, good character and purpose.
